title: Persist bounded server-owned OAuth Recovery evidence while external source authority remains fail-closed

phases.objective: Persist the five server-owned OAuth Recovery observations in the existing execution_log with exact operation, correlation and deployment binding, without claiming external callback or registration authority.

e2e_journeys.actor: Staging Tenant GPT OAuth authorization server and Activation protected-resource gateway
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Five bounded server-owned Recovery observations can be read back for one exact OAuth operation/correlation/deployment while callback_received remains absent and external Recovery source authority remains unavailable.
steps: Record authorize_received after server correlation creation.
Record login_consent_completed only after identity verification.
Record authorization_code_issued only after durable code storage and successful code signing.
Record token_exchange_completed only after access-token creation and successful activation-context persistence.
Record resource_request_verified in the Activation Gateway and await persistence before downstream dispatch.
Derive timestamps from verified correlation and deployment SHA from the canonical deployment manifest.
Persist bounded no-secret integrity evidence to execution_log with normalized correlation_id plus runtime_evidence_json, under a bounded write deadline.
Keep callback_received and Registration source attestation outside this server-owned scope.
assertions: Exactly five server-owned events are accepted and callback_received is rejected.
Explicit local_windows_docker Staging is required; ambiguous staging, staging_hosted, Production, cross-repository manifests, non-main manifests, or mismatched deployment SHA fail closed.
Caller-supplied deployment SHA or timestamps are rejected.
Canonical digest represents integrity only and source_authenticity remains not_established.
Stage-specific envelope ancestry and subject/code/access bindings are mandatory.
Readback has time, row, event-candidate, and chain-state bounds.
Recovery evidence persistence has a bounded write deadline so database queue or query stalls cannot indefinitely block OAuth or protected-resource request paths.
Recovery readback selects candidates through normalized indexed execution_log.correlation_id before verifying operation, deployment and canonical evidence bindings.
Correlation continuity is hash-linked integrity derived from verified OAuth correlation envelopes; the evidence row itself does not claim a digital signature or external source authenticity.
Production or ambiguous Staging performs no Recovery evidence DB mutation.
token_exchange_completed is absent when activation-context persistence is not stored, while the valid OAuth response remains non-fatal and Recovery certification stays incomplete.
resource_request_verified is awaited by the Gateway before downstream dispatch; persistence failure stays non-fatal to the valid request.
Gateway de-duplication is in-flight-only; successful observations are released so later verified resource requests are not suppressed.
External OAuth/Registration authority and acquisition receipt remain blocked.
